name: MEND-ARMOUR-armour-keeps-the-point
old: export const repairsObjectsMend = (it) => (it.magic || it.artifact ? CONDITION_AMOUNT : Math.max(CONDITION_AMOUNT, Math.round(it.maxCondition / MEND_SHARE_OF)));
new: export const repairsObjectsMend = (it) => (it.magic || it.artifact ? CONDITION_AMOUNT : (it.group === 'Weapons' ? Math.max(CONDITION_AMOUNT, Math.round(it.maxCondition / MEND_SHARE_OF)) : CONDITION_AMOUNT));
note: The report's law: a weapon its share, every other piece DFU's point.
